questions.q: What does Mass Delete Records recommend before you run it?
options: Disabling all validation rules on the object
Exporting your data first, as a backup
Converting the object to a custom object
Running it only in Salesforce Classic
questions.explain: The Mass Delete Records page explicitly recommends exporting your data first — the same export covered in Lesson 7 — before running a mass delete.

questions.q: What changes when you check "Permanently delete the selected records"?
options: Nothing — it's only a confirmation label with no functional effect
Deleted records skip the Recycle Bin entirely and become unrecoverable immediately
Deleted records are backed up automatically before removal
It converts the delete into a mass transfer instead
questions.explain: Leaving it unchecked sends deleted records to the Recycle Bin like a normal delete. Checking it skips the Recycle Bin entirely — those records cannot be recovered.

questions.q: Does Mass Transfer Records automatically move an Account's related Opportunities and Cases to the new owner?
options: Yes, always, with no way to opt out
No — never, under any circumstances
Only if you check the specific checkboxes for open/closed opportunities and cases
Only Opportunities move automatically; Cases never do
questions.explain: Transferring an Account doesn't automatically bring related records with it — separate checkboxes control whether open and closed opportunities and cases transfer along with it.

questions.q: What do Mass Delete and Mass Transfer have in common in how they're used?
options: Both require installing Data Loader first
Both narrow a candidate list with criteria, let you review matches, then require an explicit action to proceed
Both run entirely from the command line
Neither tool allows filtering by criteria — both act on an entire object at once
questions.explain: Both tools follow the same pattern: build criteria to narrow the list, review the actual matched records, and only then take action — rather than a single click that touches everything.

questions.q: A departing manager's open Opportunities need to go to a new rep, but closed Opportunities should stay as historical record under the old owner. What's the right Mass Transfer configuration?
options: Check both the open and closed opportunity transfer checkboxes
Check only the open-opportunity transfer checkbox, leaving closed opportunities unchecked
Use Mass Delete instead, since Mass Transfer can't be this selective
Leave both checkboxes unchecked and transfer the Account alone
questions.explain: Checking only the open-opportunity option moves active deals to the new owner while leaving closed Opportunities untouched, exactly matching the scenario.
